repo.env_config:
[build-system]
requires = [ "setuptools>=61.0",]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "json_repair"
version = "0.50.0"
license = "MIT"
license-files = [ "LICENSE",]
description = "A package to repair broken json strings"
keywords = [ "JSON", "REPAIR", "LLM", "PARSER",]
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
classifiers = [ "Programming Language :: Python :: 3", "Operating System :: OS Independent",]
[[project.authors]]
name = "Stefano Baccianella"
email = "4247706+mangiucugna@users.noreply.github.com"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/mangiucugna/json_repair/"
"Bug Tracker" = "https://github.com/mangiucugna/json_repair/issues"
"Live demo" = "https://mangiucugna.github.io/json_repair/"

[project.scripts]
json_repair = "json_repair.__main__:cli"

[tool.ruff]
indent-width = 4
line-length = 120
target-version = "py313"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [ "A", "ARG", "B", "C4", "COM", "C90", "E", "F", "I", "N", "PLC", "PLE", "PLW", "PT", "Q", "S", "SIM", "TID", "UP", "W",]
extend-select = [ "RUF001", "RUF012", "RUF013", "RUF016", "RUF018",]
ignore = [ "S101", "COM812", "E501", "C901",]
fixable = [ "ALL",]
unfixable = []

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
skip-magic-trailing-comma = false
line-ending = "auto"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = [ ".",]

[tool.coverage.run]
omit = [ "*/.cursor/extensions/*", "*/pythonFiles/lib/python/*", "*/site-packages/*",]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_also = [ "def __repr__", "if self.debug:", "if settings.DEBUG", "raise AssertionError", "raise NotImplementedError", "if 0:", "if __name__ == .__main__.:", "if TYPE_CHECKING:", "class .*\\bProtocol\\):", "@(abc\\.)?abstractmethod",]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
pkgname = [ "py.typed",]

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
icontract = "^2.7.1"

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"__init__.py" = [ "PLC0414",]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = [ "src",]

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
pytest = "^8.4.2"
pytest-cov = "^7.0.0"
pytest-reportlog = "^0.4.0"
pytest-env = "^1.2.0"
